## About
Family Barn is an indoor playground and coffee shop on Leander Rd in Georgetown. The play space is set up with babies and toddlers in mind, so the littlest ones have plenty to explore.
While the kids play, you can settle in with a coffee or a bagel from the cafe. Families have given us a 4.7 rating across 265 Google reviews, and we'd love to meet yours.

## Services
- Play area: A safe, well-kept play space where little ones can explore.
- Coffee: Coffee from our counter to enjoy while you watch the kids play.
- Bagels: Bagels from the cafe, like the mozzarella, tomato and pesto bagel one reviewer enjoyed.

## FAQ
Q: Is Family Barn a good fit for babies and toddlers?
A: Yes. One parent said the space is designed for babies and toddlers and felt very age-appropriate.

Q: Do you have an early bird session?
A: One reviewer mentioned visiting during an early bird session. Give us a call for details.

## What customers say
- "We had such a wonderful experience at Family Barn!
My daughter is 14 months old, and this was our first visit — she absolutely loved it.
The space is clean, safe, and perfectly designed for babies and toddlers. Everything felt very age-appropriate, and I loved that it wasn’t overcrowded, so she could explore and play comfortably.
The staff were friendly and welcoming, and as a parent, I really appreciated how relaxed and calm the environment felt. It’s such a great place to let little ones play while parents can actually enjoy the time too.
We will definitely be coming back. Highly recommend for anyone with young children!" (Miree Park (Miree Park Lee), 5/5)
- "Came to the Family Barn to let my little one run out some energy and I gotta say it was a great decision. Jody & Mikaela were the staff present and they were super friendly, helpful with questions, and hospitable. The Mocha I had was awesome along with the Mozzarella tomato and pesto bagel. 10/10 I will return and refer this place to others!" (Wade Sisson, 5/5)
- "Super cute little play cafe! My 2 year old and 10 month old had a great time and stayed engaged the entire time.
